role_summary: The Senior AI Engineer will own the end-to-end lifecycle of LLM features, including RAG pipelines, fine-tuning, and structured extraction, for legal and financial analyst software. Success means delivering monitored, cost-controlled, and rigorously evaluated model services directly to AWS production. Additionally, this hands-on role leads technical design discussions and mentors mid-level engineers on the growing AI team.
top_priorities: Designing and building retrieval-augmented generation pipelines and hybrid search
Fine-tuning open-weight LLMs and transformers using LoRA and QLoRA
Building rigorous offline and online model evaluation including LLM-as-judge scoring
Serving scalable, monitored, and cost-controlled models on AWS production infrastructure
Mentoring mid-level engineers and leading technical design reviews
domain: Legal and financial document intelligence - LLM applications and model serving
